O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.

description:
Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE)

Join to apply for the Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE) role at Microsoft Power Platform Community

Business Function Overview

In alignment with Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. As a CO+I CE Field Service Engineer, you will deliver core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Responsibilities

  • Ensures compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
  • Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
  • Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.
  • Demonstrates conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keeps costs reasonable and contributes to staying within budget.
  • Follows and adheres to safety and security policies and procedures. Reports immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
  • Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
  • Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters.
  • Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year.
  • Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives.
  • Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters.
  • Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed.
  • Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring.
  • Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs).
  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio.
  • Hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service).
  • Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent AND 2+ year(s) industry experience in a datacenter or other critical environment facility.
  • OR 3+ years industry experience and college course work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services.
  • Experience working on large scale CE projects.
  • Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.).

Background Check Requirements

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.

Please note that this role works 100% on-site. About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user-centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end-users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you'll do:
  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short-term feature delivery with long-term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator-friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI-driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.
What you'll need:
  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data-centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud-based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade-offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business-focused.
More about you:
  • You’re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.
What We Offer:

  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code

description:

About DPDHL and CRE:
Deutsche Post DHL (DPDHL) is the world’s logistics provider with over 600,000 employees in more than 220 countries and territories. As a global leader we connect people, improve lives, and offer personal and professional development opportunities. Corporate Real Estate (CRE) manages more than 12,000 properties worldwide, covering an area of over 30 million m² and supports a sustainable property lifecycle across Commercial, Construction and Facility Management.

Job Purpose

  • Under the direction of the Facilities Manager, coordinate overall facility management, including technical facility coordination and vendor management.
  • Oversee general facilities maintenance, approve vendor invoices, track payments in SAP, and handle special projects.
  • Prepare routine analysis and updates for the FM budget covering technical and infrastructural scopes.

Your tasks

  • Manage repairs, maintenance and upkeep of company facilities, building systems, appliances and outdoor spaces.
  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors and property managers for timely completion of maintenance tasks.
  • Coordinate custodial, landscaping and security services.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulations and codes related to building safety and maintenance.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with tenants and stakeholders to ensure high customer service levels.
  • Participate in long‑term plans for facility maintenance, upgrades and improvements, including budget development and management.
  • Provide regular reports on facility operations, expenses and projects to management.
  • Work as an individual contributor with moderate supervision.
  • Apply advanced knowledge of job procedures and tools gained through work experience and/or vocational or technical education.
  • Interpret and adapt to routine and atypical situations as required.
  • Build relationships, resolve conflict, and communicate persuasively.
  • Maintain financial control: record compliance and audit requirements, identify cost‑reduction or revenue‑growth opportunities.

Stakeholders

  • Collaborate with FM departments and business unit management.
  • Influence specialist departments and third‑party service providers.
  • Advise senior management and line managers on technical matters.
  • Build strong, trusting cross‑functional relationships with DHL managers.
  • Ensure adherence to policies and practices related to job responsibilities.

Your profile → Education Level

  • Relevant university degree in Engineering, Architecture or a Real Estate related field.
  • Bilingual in English and a local language as needed.

Your profile → Experience Level

  • 2‑5 years of relevant Facility Management / Corporate Real Estate experience.

We offer

  • Great opportunity to work for the world’s largest logistics company.
  • International and virtual working environment.
  • Flexibility and learning opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

A Brudovan Pneus foi fundada em 1973, na cidade de Campinas, pelo Sr. Domenico Micaroni e atualmente, a empresa é liderada por seus filhos, Domenico Micaroni Junior e Bruno Micaroni. Atuamos no comércio varejista e atacadista de peças, pneus e serviços, consolidando nossa presença em diferentes segmentos do mercado. Desde o início, com apenas uma loja de Auto Center, já contávamos com uma equipe de operações e de vendas altamente capacitada e atuávamos em um mercado em franca expansão. Esses fatores foram cruciais para nosso rápido crescimento e sucesso. Atualmente, possuímos quatro lojas na região de Campinas. Além disso, somos distribuidores exclusivos de pneus Michelin e óleo Castrol para motocicletas no estado de São Paulo. Expandimos nossas operações para outros estados estratégicos. Em Minas Gerais, o segundo maior mercado consumidor do Brasil, trabalhamos com marcas renomadas como Michelin, Levorin e Cobreq. No estado da Bahia, somos os distribuidores exclusivos da Motul. Nosso destaque no setor é evidente: somos o maior distribuidor de pneus Michelin do Brasil e estamos entre os três principais distribuidores da Levorin no país. Em nível internacional, figuramos entre os cinco maiores distribuidores Michelin 2R na América Latina.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Planejar e executar ações de Trade Marketing voltadas ao canal de distribuição de peças, pneus e lubrificantes de motos, garantindo a visibilidade das marcas, aumento das vendas e fortalecimento da presença nos pontos de venda (PDVs). Liderar e gerenciar as atividades de pós-venda, garantindo a satisfação dos clientes, fidelização e o suporte técnico necessário.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e executar as estratégias de marca, campanhas e ações promocionais que reforçam o posicionamento da empresa e de seus fabricantes parceiros, impulsionando a demanda (sell-out) e fortalecendo a visibilidade nos canais de venda.

Sobre nós

Imagine uma empresa com mais de 160 anos de liderança tecnológica, mas que opera com a energia de uma startup. A Ingersoll Rand se dedica a melhorar a vida de seus colaboradores, clientes, acionistas e do planeta. Ao redor do mundo, impulsionamos o crescimento com espírito empreendedor e mentalidade de dono. Saiba mais em irco.com e junte-se a nós para assumir o controle do seu futuro.

Responsável por apoiar o desenvolvimento e a execução das estratégias de sourcing e compras estratégicas da empresa, assegurando o melhor equilíbrio entre custo, qualidade, prazo e sustentabilidade.   • Colaborar com Engenharia, Qualidade e Supply Chain para atendimento às especificações técnicas e requisitos de entrega.
  • Analisar dados de mercado e tendências para apoiar decisões estratégicas de compras.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Engenharia.
  • Conhecimento em processos de compras técnicas e estratégicas.
  • Experiência com compras de grandes projetos industriais.
  • Experiência com análise de custo total (TCO) e desenvolvimento de estratégias de redução de custos.
  • Entendimento de práticas de conformidade e sustentabilidade em cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos e especificações técnicas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação e negociação com fornecedores globais.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP.

Viagens e Modalidade de Trabalho

  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Modelo híbrido: 1 dia de home office na semana.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you’ll do:

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;

Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a "verem mais e serem mais" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.

Nosso portfolio incomparável de marcas exclusivas de óculos, como Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear e Costa, é complementado por mais de 20 marcas licenciadas de prestígio. Nossas tecnologias avançadas de lentes incluem a marca Essilor, com Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest e Transitions. O negócio é complementado por plataformas líderes de comércio eletrônico, como Ray-Ban.com, EyeBuyDirect, Clearly e muito mais.

title: Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas
description:
Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

title: Pesquisador Fermentação Sr
description:
Na Amyris, somos pioneiros no uso de micróbios para transformar açúcares derivados de plantas em moléculas de alto desempenho em larga escala. Nossa plataforma abre acesso à química requintada e sofisticada encontrada em todos os sistemas vivos, levando a novas possibilidades de produtos, oportunidades de mercado e soluções de sustentabilidade. Com escala comprovada, estamos redefinindo o que a química renovável pode fazer.

Aqui na Amyris, somos um time de pessoas criativas e inovadoras. Nós valorizamos as relações saudáveis em diferentes perspectivas e nos empenhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, abrangendo diferentes raças, etnias, gêneros, religiões, pessoas com deficiências e comunidade LGBTQIA+.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades

  • Investigar de maneira aprofundada em literatura científica mecanismos que podem vir a gerar ganhos aos processos produtivos Amyris ou que auxiliem na resolução de problemas complexos durante o desenvolvimento dos processos, na manufatura ou nos diferentes CMOs;
  • Planejar experimentos em escala piloto e de bancada necessários para o desenvolvimento de processos de fermentação das diferentes moléculas do portfolio da companhia ou para troubleshooting de campanhas de produção para que atinjam os KPIs/qualidade planejados;
  • Utilizar softwares de análise estatística para analisar os dados de cada experimento e compará-los/gerar correlações com os dados disponíveis da manufatura ou de experimentos anteriores;
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos em língua portuguesa e inglesa compilando todas as metodologias, resultados e conclusões de cada um dos experimentos executados no PD;
  • Preparar documentos de transferência de tecnologia;
  • Preparar apresentações para os diferentes fóruns de discussão de resultados, inclusive com a matriz nos Estados Unidos;
  • Realizar treinamentos e suportes de campanhas de produção de acordo com a necessidade da empresa;
  • Preparar requisições de compras para materiais necessários ao desenvolvimento de processos. Organizar transportes de amostras e preparo de documentação necessária para análises externas.
  • Acompanhamento de auditorias de segurança, biossegurança, qualidade, processos, etc (conforme determinado pelo coordenador da área);
  • Liderar projetos estratégicos da companhia, quando houver demanda/oportunidade (PTL).
  • Treinar novos pesquisadores, engenheiros de processos ou técnicos de fermentação nos processos Amyris, nos conceitos importantes de cada projeto, para cada molécula;
  • Utilizar ferramentas avançadas de planejamento de experimentos, DOEs, DCCRs, PBs para avaliação de efeitos isolados e sinergias de variáveis de processo sob os resultados dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos no PD;
  • Ter uma visão sistêmica de processos envolvendo múltiplas áreas (Fermentação, DSP, Qualidade, Regulatórios, Segurança) estabelecendo conexões com as áreas de interface e avaliando os processos Amyris de forma ampla.

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em: Química, Biologia, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia de Bioprocessos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimento em softwares de análise estatística de dados (JMP, Minitab, Statistica);
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Office – Word/Excel/Powerpoint;
  • Experiência em redação de relatórios técnicos, transferências de tecnologia e análises de dados/análises estatísticas geradas a partir dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos na planta piloto.

description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the role:

Are you passionate about connecting great talent with the right opportunities and eager to grow your career in Talent Acquisition? We are looking for a Junior Talent Acquisition Analyst to join our People team and support full‑cycle recruitment for tech and business roles within our Global Growth Group.

As part of a global organization, you will collaborate with teams across different countries — contributing to a high‑impact, candidate‑focused recruitment experience.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage end‑to‑end recruitment processes, with a focus on tech roles, ensuring a smooth and candidate‑centered experience.
  • Conduct intake meetings with hiring managers to align expectations, define role requirements, and understand team context.
  • Craft and publish job descriptions using Greenhouse and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Screen resumes using keyword and competency criteria, identifying top talent efficiently.
  • Actively source candidates through hunting, Boolean strategies, networking, and market mapping.
  • Lead competency‑based and cultural‑fit interviews.
  • Coordinate and schedule technical interviews with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide structured, timely, and actionable feedback to candidates and hiring teams.
  • Manage offer processes, ensuring alignment between candidate needs and organizational guidelines.
  • Track recruitment pipelines, maintaining workflow quality, data accuracy, transparency, and clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to hiring managers, keeping them informed, aligned, and on track throughout the process.
  • Support continuous improvements by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, standards, and tools.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in recruitment, ideally with exposure to tech positions.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, high‑volume, or tech‑driven environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Excel for building reports and PowerPoint for presentations.
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS), ideally Greenhouse.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining process quality and a strong candidate experience.
  • A proactive, organized, and detail‑oriented approach, with willingness to learn and grow.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

#TechEY

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Você irá atuar em cliente global de grande porte, com oportunidade de crescimento. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.

  • Colaborar com stakeholders para coletar requisitos de relatórios e traduzi-los em visualizações de dados eficazes;
  • Criar modelos de dados e otimizar fontes de dados para garantir alto desempenho e precisão nos relatórios;
  • Conduzir testes e validação de relatórios para assegurar integridade e usabilidade dos dados;
  • Fornecer treinamento e suporte aos usuários finais sobre funcionalidades e melhores práticas do QlikSense e QlikView.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Formação completa/cursando nas áreas de Tecnologia, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Matemática, Estatística, Engenharias e ou correlatas;

  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.

O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Wellhub, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

description:

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

About The Team

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Role

As a Credit Risk Specialist within our Credit Risk Squad (part of the 2nd Line of Defense), you will play a crucial role in supporting Nubank’s world class risk management framework. Your primary focus will be on expected credit loss models development and maintenance, particularly within the retail market portfolios, including credit cards and personal loans. You will contribute significantly to ensuring the company’s credit risk is managed effectively, with a strong emphasis on the universe of credit provisions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

  • Developing, implementing, analysing and monitoring risk parameter models (PD, LGD, EAD) relevant to our retail portfolios, ensuring they align with regulations like IFRS9 and 4966. You will be instrumental in making sure we have state of the art models also through activities such as backtesting, data analysis, documentation and operational monitoring.
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations concerning provisions and credit risk management, including a surface-level understanding of standards like Bacen 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Performing in-depth analysis of credit risk exposure and its implications for expected credit losses (ECL) and loss allowances. This will involve understanding how changes in the credit portfolio impact our provisions.
  • Participating in monthly accounting closing activities, contributing to the creation of reports on loss allowance movements.
  • Actively contributing to the enhancement of our controls environment within credit risk management. This is crucial for ensuring compliance with regulations such as SOX.
  • Liaising with Internal and External Audit teams during model validation processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and SOX compliance in our operational processes.
  • Leveraging your analytical and problem-solving skills to manipulate and learn from data related to the credit portfolio.
  • This role requires a strong analytical background, a keen understanding of credit risk principles, and the ability to contribute to a robust and compliant credit risk management framework. Your work will directly impact the accuracy of our financial reporting and the overall stability of our credit operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Math, Statistics, Physics or related fields
  • Analytical, problem solving and passionate to manipulate data in order to learn from it
  • Great coding skills (SQL, Python, Scala or other similar programming languages)
  • Experience in developing or analyzing outputs of Expected Credit Loss models/PD/EAD/LGD for credit provisioning purposes
  • Adaptability to dynamic way of working/short term deliverables

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • Experience with SOX controls within risk management environment

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit

Employment type

description:
Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

title: Retail Credit Risk Specialist
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the team

The Credit Risk Squad is part of the 2nd line of Defense, responsible for managing and overseeing the credit risk function of our organization by providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line of defense. As a second line Credit Risk team, we are responsible for creating Expected Credit Losses (ECL) models that are used to calculate loss allowances, making sure the company’s credit risk is managed correctly and efficiently, participating end-to-end in the model development process, including, implementation,monitoring, ensuring operational quality of the data and supporting Finance accounting teams.

About the Role

As a Credit Risk Specialist within our Credit Risk Squad (part of the 2nd Line of Defense), you will play a crucial role in supporting Nubank’s world class risk management framework. Your primary focus will be on expected credit loss models development and maintenance, particularly within the retail market portfolios, including credit cards and personal loans. You will contribute significantly to ensuring the company’s credit risk is managed effectively, with a strong emphasis on the universe of credit provisions.

Responsibilities

  • Developing, implementing, analysing and monitoring risk parameter models (PD, LGD, EAD) relevant to our retail portfolios, ensuring they align with regulations like IFRS9 and 4966. You will be instrumental in making sure we have state of the art models also through activities such as backtesting, data analysis, documentation and operational monitoring.
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations concerning provisions and credit risk management, including a surface-level understanding of standards like Bacen 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Performing in-depth analysis of credit risk exposure and its implications for expected credit losses (ECL) and loss allowances. This will involve understanding how changes in the credit portfolio impact our provisions.
  • Participating in monthly accounting closing activities, contributing to the creation of reports on loss allowance movements.
  • Actively contributing to the enhancement of our controls environment within credit risk management. This is crucial for ensuring compliance with regulations such as SOX.
  • Liaising with Internal and External Audit teams during model validation processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and SOX compliance in our operational processes.
  • Leveraging your analytical and problem-solving skills to manipulate and learn from data related to the credit portfolio.
  • This role requires a strong analytical background, a keen understanding of credit risk principles, and the ability to contribute to a robust and compliant credit risk management framework. Your work will directly impact the accuracy of our financial reporting and the overall stability of our credit operations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Math, Statistics, Physics or related fields
  • Analytical, problem solving and passionate to manipulate data in order to learn from it
  • Great coding skills (SQL, Python, Scala or other similar programming languages)
  • Experience in developing or analyzing outputs of Expected Credit Loss models/PD/EAD/LGD for credit provisioning purposes
  • Adaptability to dynamic way of working/short term deliverables

Preferred qualifications

  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • Experience with SOX controls within risk management environment

description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the NYSE (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Team

At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning and other quantitative models & techniques to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers. The position holder will be part of the Model Risk team within the Risk Management structure at Nubank. The Model Risk team is the second line of defense for our models. Our mission is to ensure Nubank relies on world‑class solutions that will lead to optimal and sustainable decisions. We act by providing independent review & challenge to models, staying tuned to cutting‑edge techniques, along with business and customers needs. We also work to identify and control risks related to our models and define and implement feedback loops to constantly improve them.

About The Role

  • Provide effective challenges, identify risks and enhancement opportunities, and engage with other Data Scientists and Business Analysts to strengthen our decision‑making tools;
  • Discuss and report model risk status and independent opinions on models with different stakeholders, including senior managers and regulators;
  • Contribute to the consolidation of and improve Nubank’s Model Risk Management and Model Review frameworks with autonomy and creativity;
  • Be exposed to different types of decisions and processes (e.g., credit, fraud, operations and in different countries).
  • Conduct independent reviews of quantitative models based on statistical, machine learning and AI techniques, with a stronger focus on credit models;
  • Develop playbooks and toolkits (Python, Scala, SQL, etc.) to optimize model reviews, ongoing models monitoring, and assess the impact of models in decisions;
  • Ensure the team maintains a high level of technical excellence.

We Are Looking For a Person Who Has

  • Great communication skills: clear, concise and structured.
  • Problem‑solving skills: strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities are essential for identifying risk factors and implementing effective risk management strategies.
  • Experience developing or validating machine learning models used to leverage important decision‑making processes or to solve relevant academic problems.
  • Interest in reviewing complex machine learning and other types of models to identify risks and propose enhancements.
  • Ability to work autonomously and demonstrate a sense of prioritization.
  • Data Science skills, strong knowledge of machine learning tools and techniques.
  • Strong programming skills, desirable previous experience with Python, SQL, GitHub.
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across levels.
  • Organized and detail‑oriented, without losing track of the big picture.
  • Advanced English skills.
  • Previous experience in credit risk management and/or other risk management frameworks would be a plus.
  • Master’s degree or relevant undergraduate scientific project would be a plus.
  • Previous knowledge of expected loss provisions modeling would be a plus.

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

A Turner & Townsend é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais com mais de 22.000 colaboradores em mais de 60 países. Trabalhando com nossos clientes nos setores de imobiliário, infraestrutura, energia e recursos naturais, transformamos juntos, entregando resultados que melhoram a vida das pessoas. Nós nos destacamos em gestão de programas, projetos, custos, ativos e comerciais, controles de desempenho, compras e cadeia de suprimentos, e soluções para emissões zero e digital.

O Engenheiro de Projetos de HVAC e Utilidades é responsável por garantir e validar os projetos de climatização e ventilação, sejam projetados, instalados e comissionados em total conformidade com as normas técnicas, regulamentações e padrões de qualidade. Atua no acompanhamento da execução, inspeção e comissionamento de sistemas de ar-condicionado, ventilação mecânica e exaustão, além de coordenar equipes e contratados.

Responsabilidades

  • Analisar projetos e desenhos técnicos de sistemas HVAC e utilidades, assegurando conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais.
  • Supervisionar a instalação de sistemas de ar-condicionado (VRF, split, chillers, fancoils, AHU/UTA), ventilação e exaustão em ambientes comerciais, industriais ou institucionais e sistemas de filtragem de ar.
  • Apoiar equipe de PMO no desenvolvimento de cronogramas de execução e na elaboração de estimativas de custo e planejamento físico-financeiro.
  • Fiscalizar a instalação de sistemas de armazenamento e distribuição de água, sistemas de combate a incêndio, armazenamento e distribuição de gases especiais e efluentes industriais, armazenamento e distribuição de ar comprimido e geração e distribuição de vapor.
  • Realizar inspeções técnicas em dutos, equipamentos e componentes de HVAC, garantindo a qualidade da instalação.
  • Planejar e acompanhar atividades de testes, pré-comissionamento e comissionamento dos sistemas.
  • Aplicar normas de segurança e boas práticas de engenharia durante todas as fases do projeto.
  • Participar de revisões de projeto e reuniões técnicas com clientes, projetistas e empreiteiros.
  • Garantir a correta interpretação de escopos e documentos técnicos, esclarecendo dúvidas da equipe de campo.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e participar de reuniões de acompanhamento com stakeholders.
  • Manter comunicação constante com as operações do cliente para alinhar intervenções e minimizar impactos nas áreas ocupadas.

Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em supervisão de projetos HVAC e sistemas de utilidades.
  • Desejável experiência em projetos e/ou obras de indústrias farmacêuticas, laboratórios, hospitais e similares.
  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento técnico em sistemas de ar-condicionado central, automação predial, ventilação e exaustão.
  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas (ASHRAE, ABNT, NR-13, NR-35, entre outras).
  • Experiência com sistemas de proteção contra incêndio será um diferencial.
  • Domínio das ferramentas do Microsoft Office.

A Turner & Townsend é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários, incentivando ativamente candidaturas de todos os setores da comunidade.

Somos uma empresa de cibersegurança orientada a viabilizar as estratégias de negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções seguras, flexíveis e inovadoras.

  • Monitorar o progresso das vendas e garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Overview

About Sierra Studio

When you apply to Sierra, you join an ecosystem. We specialize in connecting talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted small community of growing companies in the US. Applying to Sierra seamlessly integrates you into this ecosystem, granting automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities we offer.

About our hiring partner

Our hiring partner is a consumer product development company. They help companies make new products & bring them to market, leading concepting, design, engineering, supply chain setup & ongoing operational oversight. They have teams in New York City, Hong Kong and beyond. They work with startups and established companies across many consumer categories; from connected hardware & electronics, to durable housewares and in-home goods, to soft-goods and packaging, and everything in between.

Who our hiring partner is looking for

They are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join their team. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling, prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer will be a member of our hiring partner's Brazil team - The position can be remote but will report to the Staff Engineer out of Campinas/SP. The Brazil team reports into the Head of Product based in HQ in NYC.

The Candidate

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on challenges.

The Job

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

Responsibilities

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components. Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

The Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • High level proficiency in English language- written and spoken

Working Hours

While our work involves coordination predominantly with NY Team, there are meetings that are scheduled outside of traditional 9-6 working hours to accommodate the HK team. We trust all team members to manage their schedules and to take appropriate measures to take care of themselves and their wellbeing.

Job description

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união, tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem‑estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso à saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 5 Hubs operacionais nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, compondo uma rede com 9 hospitais, mais de 1.300 leitos, 7.500 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the job

The Product Manager for BEES Deliver will play a pivotal role in driving the product evolution and development of our logistics digital transformation solution. This role involves leading cross-functional teams to enhance product features, optimize connectivity with the BEES ecosystem, and ensure a seamless delivery experience for our global customers. The Product Manager will be responsible for structuring the core journey of BEES Deliver to become a global product and expand its reach with minimal customizations.

What you'll do:

  • Guide Product Discoveries: Collaborate with engineering, UX/UI, sales, and logistics teams to define the users’ problems to be solved and how to find optimal solutions for them, transforming this into product evolution requirements.
  • Define Requirements: Create high-level requirements to document all findings and definitions from the discovery phase.
  • Epics creation and management: Create epics and manage the Epic board, including detailing, status updates, and identifying affected countries.
  • User Stories Creation: Write and manage User Stories, ensuring they are well-defined, with adequate acceptance criteria, and aligned with the product vision.
  • Lead execution of the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • User Research: Collaborate with UX Research to align research materials, scripts, and scopes to gain insights into user behavior.
  • Prototype Development: Partner with Product Design to support them in the creation of effective prototypes.
  • Architectural Planning: Work with Architects to support them in the creation of the architecture solution for new initiatives and map out dependencies.
  • Tracking Plan: Collaborate with the Data Team to establish a segment tracking plan.
  • Measure Hypothesis: Monitor product performance and customer feedback, using data-driven insights to inform decision-making.
  • Manage project timelines and resources to ensure timely delivery of product milestones.

What you'll need:

  • Experience as a Product Manager in an e-commerce, logistics or tech environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Ability to think strategically and execute methodically.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Familiarity with software development methodologies and tools such as Mixpanel and JIRA.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment, and adapt to changing priorities.

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance

title: Enfermeiro(a) Oncológico / Centro de Oncologia Vera Cruz
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • A Enfermeira Navegadora Oncológica será responsável por
  • Realizar o acolhimento integral do paciente em todas as etapas do tratamento, estabelecendo uma relação de confiança e oferecendo suporte contínuo;
  • Atuar como elo entre os setores hospitalares e a clínica de oncologia, garantindo comunicação eficiente, organização dos fluxos e a integração das informações assistenciais.
  • Acompanhar diário do paciente internado;
  • Monitorar suas necessidades;
  • Orientar sobre procedimentos e etapas do tratamento, além do auxílio em processos administrativos;
  • Agendamentos, encaminhamentos e suporte às demandas da equipe multiprofissional.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar treinamentos específicos na área de oncologia, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe e para a padronização de práticas seguras.

Respect

Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non‑bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

description:
Overview

Fazemos parte do Grupo BTG Pactual, maior banco de investimento da américa latina. Nosso propósito é transformar ativos desvalorizados no mercado de crédito e real estate. Atuamos na gestão de créditos inadimplentes corporativos, ajudando fundos, investidores, instituições financeiras e empresas a encontrarem soluções estratégicas para seus negócios. Isso é possível, devido às nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Principais destaques

Alguns dos nossos destaques:

  • Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.
  • Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.
  • Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

Nossa comunidade é formada por 300 colaboradores e 170 parceiros, que atuam com proatividade, inovação, excelência, senso de dono e foco no cliente. Em um ambiente que valoriza o empreendedorismo, a meritocracia e o foco no cliente, promovemos uma cultura de resultados e crescimento profissional contínuo.

Utilizamos banco de dados PostgreSQL e com micro serviços desenvolvidos em Python (flask) e frontend em Angular. Toda nossa estrutura é “dockerizada” rodando em kubernetes e integrada utilizando tópicos (SNS) e filas (SQS). Também fazemos uso do Elasticsearch para otimizar nossas consultas. Tudo sendo provido pela AWS. Também temos toda uma esteira de CI/CD com testes automatizados provido pela Microsoft Azure Devops.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Python (Flask ou FastAPI), garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade;
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura técnica e para o desenho de soluções que traduzam demandas de negócio em sistemas robustos e eficientes;
  • Implantar integrações e automações utilizando o ecossistema AWS (EventBridge, SQS, RDS, Lambda, S3, entre outros);
  • Atuar na observabilidade e sustentação de aplicações em ambiente Kubernetes, com foco em confiabilidade e resiliência;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, dados e negócios) para evoluir continuamente a plataforma tecnológica da Enforce;
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e estratégicas de arquitetura e infraestrutura.

Requisitos

  • +8 anos de experiência em engenharia de software, utilizamos Python e frameworks modernos (Flask, FastAPI ou similares) mas caso você venha do Java e tenha desejo de trabalhar com nossa stack não será problema;
  • Vivência em ambientes baseados em microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (preferencialmente EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, RDS e S3);
  • Conhecimentos em orquestração de containers com Kubernetes;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de alta qualidade;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com iniciativa e foco em resultados.

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams.
